## Typography

Body text and headings are set in Source Serif Pro, with *italic* and
**bold** variants. Here is [a link](https://stefan.langenbach.online)
and some inline code: `quarto add slangenbach/slangenbach-brand`.

```python
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}!"
```

## Colours

[paper]{style="color: var(--brand-paper); background: var(--brand-ink)"} ·
[ink]{style="color: var(--brand-ink)"} ·
[ink-muted]{style="color: var(--brand-ink-muted)"} ·
[rule]{style="color: var(--brand-rule)"} ·
[accent]{style="color: var(--brand-accent)"} ·
[code-paper]{style="background: var(--brand-code-paper)"}
